DispositionRequest.description: Request model for creating or updating a disposition.

id.description: The unique identifier of the disposition.

leadId.description: The ID of the lead this disposition is associated with.

outcome.description: The outcome or result of the disposition.

notes.description: Additional notes or comments about the disposition.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the disposition occurred.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the disposition was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the disposition was last updated.

GenderType.description: Represents a gender classification used for demographic or identification purposes.

firstName.description: Gets or sets the first name of the lead.

lastName.description: Gets or sets the last name (surname) of the lead.

email.description: Gets or sets the email address of the lead.

LeadContact.description: Represents the primary contact details for a lead, including name, address, phone, and email.

utmSource.description: The source of the lead traffic (e.g., "google", "facebook").

utmMedium.description: The medium used to acquire the lead (e.g., "cpc", "email").

utmCampaign.description: The UTM campaign name used for marketing attribution (e.g., "fall-promo").

utmTerm.description: The UTM search term or keyword supplied with the lead.

utmContent.description: The UTM content value supplied with the lead.

referrer.description: The full referring URL or page that originated the lead.

landingPage.description: The landing page or form endpoint used to submit the lead.

subId.description: A sub-source identifier, often representing a placement or internal variant. May be truncated or character-normalized.

pubId.description: A publisher ID representing the partner or platform that supplied the lead.

ipAddress.description: The IP address of the user who submitted the lead.

userAgent.description: The user agent string from the browser or device used during lead submission.

externalId.description: Identifier of the lead in an external or third-party system.

sellerLeadId.description: Identifier assigned by the seller or upstream lead vendor.

createdAt.description: The UTC timestamp when the lead was generated.

price.description: The monetary value or payout assigned to this lead.

directPostPrice.description: Direct-post price supplied by an upstream source. This is preserved separately from normalized lead price.

sourceMetadata.description: Additional non-sensitive source metadata supplied with the intake request.

assignedPhoneNumberId.description: Internal sender selected for this lead when a lead-level assignment exists.

smsConsentStatus.description: Lead-level SMS consent state used to block outreach after STOP and re-enable after START.

trustedFormUrl.description: A URL pointing to the ActiveProspect TrustedForm certificate. Required.

userId.description: The user that owns this lead

businessId.description: The business that owns this lead. New writes must set this; legacy records can be backfilled from source/user ownership.

LeadMetadata.description: Metadata related to the origin, context, and attribution of a submitted lead.

height.description: The lead prospect's height in inches

weight.description: The lead prospect's weight in pounds

income.description: The lead prospect's income in dollars

isHomeowner.description: true if the lead prospect is a homeowner

monthsAtResidence.description: How many months has the lead prospect lived at their current residence?

hasBankruptcy.description: true if the lead prospect experienced bankruptcy in the last 7 years

numberOfDependents.description: The lead prospect's number of dependents

hasMedicalCondition.description: true if the lead has any pre-existing medical conditions

LeadProfile.description: Represents a lead prospect's profile, containing demographic and financial information.

id.description: The unique identifier of the lead.

firstName.description: The first name of the lead's contact. This column is orderable and searchable.

lastName.description: The last name of the lead's contact. This column is orderable and searchable.

phone.description: The phone number of the lead's contact. This column is orderable and searchable.

email.description: The email address of the lead's contact. This column is orderable and searchable.

businessName.description: The name of the business associated with this lead. This column is orderable and searchable.

sourceName.description: The name of the source associated with this lead. This column is orderable and searchable.

LeadTableRow.description: Represents a row of lead data used in a data table, with mapped fields from the contact and lead models.

number.description: The lead's phone number in required format: +1 followed by 10 digits (e.g. +11234567890)

type.description: The upstream phone type when supplied by the lead source, for example mobile, landline, or voip.

Phone.description: Represents a phone number associated with an entity, including its type and additional information.

number.description: The phone number that was looked up

isValid.description: Whether the phone number is valid

PhoneLookup.description: Represents phone information retrieved from a phone number lookup

id.description: The unique identifier of the source.

apiKey.description: The API key of the source. This column is orderable and searchable.

apiKeyPreview.description: The masked API key preview safe to show after initial issuance.

enabled.description: The status of the source (enabled/disabled). This column is orderable and searchable.

businessId.description: The business ID associated with this source.

SourceTableRow.description: Represents a row of source data used in a data table, with mapped fields from the source model.

brand.description: The brand of the card (e.g., Visa, MasterCard)

last4.description: The last 4 digits of the card number

expMonth.description: The expiration month of the card

expYear.description: The expiration year of the card

isDefault.description: Whether this payment method is set as the default

createdAt.description: When the payment method was created (optional, if available)

StripePaymentMethodResponse.description: Represents a saved payment method (e.g., card) for user display

gatewayId.description: Payment gateway provided id (e.g. Stripe Payment Intent ID)

correlationId.description: Id to correlate related records (e.g. LeadId)

createdBy.description: User ID that created the record

modifiedBy.description: User ID that modified the record

id.description: The unique identifier of the transaction.

accountId.description: The account ID associated with the transaction.

leadId.description: The lead ID associated with the transaction.

createdAt.description: The creation date of the transaction record.

createdBy.description: The user who created the transaction.

TransactionTableRow.description: Represents a row of transaction data used in a data table.
